### NETSCOUT to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


November 4, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/726993193/files/doc_news/NETSCOUT-to-Participate-in-Upcoming-Investor-Conferences-be7ab262f-2026.pdf)


WESTFORD, Mass.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[NETSCOUT SYSTEMS, INC.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.netscout.com%2F&esheet=54634740&newsitemid=20261104469209&lan=en-US&anchor=NETSCOUT+SYSTEMS%2C+INC.&index=1&md5=05e5800a656b4ba3255bc6f940a51e3d) (NASDAQ: NTCT), a leading provider of network observability, AIOps, carrier service assurance, cybersecurity, and DDoS attack protection, today announced that CFO Tony Piazza, CTO Representative Dr. Vikram Saksena, and VP Corporate Finance Scott Dressel will participate in the following investor conferences.


**RBC Capital Markets Global Technology, Internet, Media and Telecommunications (TIMT) Conference**


- Wednesday, November 18, 2026
- New York, NY
- 8:40 a.m. ET fireside chat with Mr. Piazza and Dr. Saksena
- One-on-one investor meetings


**7th Annual Needham Virtual Tech Week Conference**


- Thursday, November 19, 2026
- One-on-one investor meetings


**UBS Global Technology and AI Conference**


- Wednesday, December 2, 2026
- Scottsdale, AZ
- One-on-one investor meetings


A live webcast of the fireside chat will be accessible on NETSCOUT’s[investor relations](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.netscout.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54634740&newsitemid=20261104469209&lan=en-US&anchor=investor+relations&index=2&md5=20bba73b1d312f3901504f2bd042be41)[website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.netscout.com%2F&esheet=54634740&newsitemid=20261104469209&lan=en-US&anchor=website&index=3&md5=b4375d8aaaf9b12272468e2c35c79f3b) . A replay of the webcast will be available for a limited period of time following the conference.


**About NETSCOUT** NETSCOUT SYSTEMS, INC. (NASDAQ: NTCT) protects the connected world from cyberattacks and performance and availability disruptions through its unique visibility platform and solutions powered by its pioneering deep packet inspection at scale technology. As a leading provider of network observability, AIOps, carrier service assurance, cybersecurity, and Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attack protection solutions, NETSCOUT serves the world’s largest enterprises, service providers, and public sector organizations. Learn more at[www.netscout.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.netscout.com&esheet=54634740&newsitemid=20261104469209&lan=en-US&anchor=www.netscout.com&index=4&md5=20eacf50fbfd035448bf84842660a620) or follow @NETSCOUT on[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fnetscout%2F&esheet=54634740&newsitemid=20261104469209&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=5&md5=2063d92827dd2e975181a35134229d5c) ,[X](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FNETSCOUT&esheet=54634740&newsitemid=20261104469209&lan=en-US&anchor=X&index=6&md5=82dfd655b06f290801b525769b2e905e) , or[Facebook](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fnetscoutinc%2F&esheet=54634740&newsitemid=20261104469209&lan=en-US&anchor=Facebook&index=7&md5=046f7cdc00f6c745900e1b0509203320) .
